    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The 100% Critical Failure",
      "goal": "Protagonist Arlo is isekai'd into 'Aethelgard Online' and discovers that his 'Luck' stat is so low it has integer-overflowed into a guaranteed 'Crit Hit' on every strike, provided he is running away.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From confused victim to accidental glass-cannon exploiter.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arlo's mundane life ends in a freak vending machine accident.",
        "to_next": "Arlo realizes he needs a way to monetize his 'Run' mechanic without getting killed by the first mob that touches him."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Vending Machine Incident",
          "intent": "Establish Arlo's mundane life and his transition to the game world via a comedic death.",
          "end_condition": "Arlo dies and begins the reincarnation process into Aethelgard Online.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Arlo attempts to retrieve a stuck soda from a vending machine.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arlo kicks the machine, causing it to wobble dangerously.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "City Sidewalk",
              "location_end_label": "City Sidewalk",
              "location_start": "A concrete sidewalk next to a rusty vending machine.",
              "location_end": "A concrete sidewalk next to a wobbling vending machine.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Arlo stares at the stuck bottle of Cherry Blast.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["stuck soda bottle", "rusty vending machine", "Arlo's frustration"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2",
              "transition_out_text": "The machine groans under the force of Arlo's kick.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["metal groan", "heavy vibration", "precarious tilt"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "The machine falls, crushing Arlo and sending him into the void.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Arlo is crushed and begins the reincarnation process.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "City Sidewalk",
              "location_end_label": "The Void",
              "location_start": "A concrete sidewalk next to a wobbling vending machine.",
              "location_end": "A dark, flickering space between worlds.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "The metal housing gives way with a screech.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["falling shadow", "shattered glass", "last breath"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "hands_off_to": "1:3",
              "transition_out_text": "Darkness consumes the sidewalk as Arlo's consciousness slips.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["fading vision", "distant sirens", "approaching silence"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Arlo dies and begins the reincarnation process into Aethelgard Online."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Character Sheet Disaster",
          "intent": "Introduce the game mechanics and Arlo's devastatingly low Luck stat.",
          "end_condition": "Arlo confirms his -999 Luck has triggered an 'Overflow' status on his character sheet.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Arlo wakes up in the resurrection shrine of Aethelgard Online.",
              "type": "arrival",
              "outcome": "Arlo realizes he is inside a video game world.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "The Void",
              "location_end_label": "Resurrection Shrine",
              "location_start": "A dark, flickering space between worlds.",
              "location_end": "A stone platform surrounded by blue floating particles.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "sheltered",
              "transition_in_text": "A chime rings as Arlo gasps for air on cold stone.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["stone altar", "blue particles", "system chime"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "transition_out_text": "He pushes himself up, looking at his new, translucent hands.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["low-poly skin", "glowing runes", "shrine pillars"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Arlo opens his character sheet for the first time.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Arlo sees his stats and is horrified by his Luck score.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Resurrection Shrine",
              "location_end_label": "Resurrection Shrine",
              "location_start": "A stone platform surrounded by blue floating particles.",
              "location_end": "The edge of the shrine overlooking the fields.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Arlo swipes his hand down to summon the menu.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["holographic screen", "stat list", "menu swipe"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "hands_off_to": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "His eyes widen as he scrolls to the bottom of the list.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stat numbers", "scrolling text", "mounting dread"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Arlo notices the 'Overflow' status next to his Luck stat.",
              "type": "mystery",
              "outcome": "Arlo confirms his -999 Luck has triggered an 'Overflow' status.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_LUCK_OVERFLOW"],
              "location_start_label": "Resurrection Shrine",
              "location_end_label": "Resurrection Shrine",
              "location_start": "The edge of the shrine overlooking the fields.",
              "location_end": "The shrine's exit stairs.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Luck stat flickers with a strange, oily red light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["negative numbers", "overflow tag", "red light"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "hands_off_to": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "He steps off the shrine, unsure what 'Overflow' actually means.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stone steps", "shrine boundary", "uncertain path"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Arlo confirms his -999 Luck has triggered an 'Overflow' status on his character sheet."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Slime Sprint",
          "intent": "Demonstrate the 'Crit Hit & Run' exploit through a low-stakes combat encounter.",
          "end_condition": "Arlo successfully kills a slime while running away, realizing his retreat-based attacks are guaranteed criticals.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Arlo encounters a low-level slime in the starting field.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arlo attempts to fight but is nearly killed by a simple bounce.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_start": "A grassy field dotted with digital daisies.",
              "location_end": "A muddy patch of grass near a bouncing slime.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "A squelching sound draws Arlo's attention to a green blob.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["green slime", "bouncing animation", "health bar"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "hands_off_to": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "The slime lunges, hitting Arlo with a wet thud.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["slime impact", "health drop", "staggering back"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Arlo tries to attack the slime head-on and misses repeatedly.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arlo realizes his Luck makes standard combat impossible.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_start": "A muddy patch of grass near a bouncing slime.",
              "location_end": "The edge of a small clearing.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Arlo swings his rusty sword with a desperate yell.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rusty sword", "missed swing", "slime dodge"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "transition_out_text": "Panic sets in as the slime prepares for another leap.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["mounting panic", "low health warning", "slime charging"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Arlo turns to run, swings his sword backward, and one-shots the slime.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Arlo discovers the 'Crit Hit & Run' exploit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_LUCK_OVERFLOW"],
              "location_start_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_start": "The edge of a small clearing.",
              "location_end": "A patch of grass covered in slime residue.",
              "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Arlo turns tail and sprints, swinging blindly behind him.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sprinting away", "backward swing", "critical hit chime"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "The slime explodes into a shower of gold coins and experience points.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["gold coins", "experience bar", "slime residue"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Arlo successfully kills a slime while running away, realizing his retreat-based attacks are guaranteed criticals."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Kiting the Tutorial Boss",
      "goal": "Arlo must defeat the Tutorial Guardian using only retreat-based attacks to secure enough starting gold for a 'Dash' skill book.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From penniless newbie to a player with a unique, albeit cowardly, combat style.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arlo identifies the 'Coward's Strike' exploit.",
        "to_next": "The massive loot drop from the Guardian flags Arlo's account for 'unusual activity' in the local region."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Grinding the Coward's Way",
          "intent": "Show Arlo refining his 'retreat-strike' technique on tutorial mobs to gather basic gear.",
          "end_condition": "Arlo reaches the Tutorial Guardian's gate equipped with basic gear and a plan.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Arlo spends time hunting more slimes and wolves by running away.",

              "outcome": "Arlo levels up and gains confidence in his backward-swing technique.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Starting Fields",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Path",

              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",

              "transition_out_anchors": ["inventory icon", "sweat wipe", "level 5"],
              "callbacks": ["THREAD_LUCK_OVERFLOW"]

            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Arlo loots a pair of leather boots from a rare wolf drop.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Arlo improves his movement speed.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Path",

              "location_start": "A dirt path leading toward the mountains.",
              "location_end": "A small campfire site on the path.",

              "transition_out_anchors": ["leather laces", "agility buff", "campfire glow"]

            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Arlo arrives at the massive iron gates of the Guardian's Arena.",
              "type": "arrival",
              "outcome": "Arlo reaches the Guardian's gate with a plan.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Path",

              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "transition_out_text": "He takes a deep breath and pushes the heavy doors open.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["heavy doors", "deep breath", "arena entrance"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Arlo reaches the Tutorial Guardian's gate equipped with basic gear and a plan."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Guardian's Arena",
          "intent": "A high-intensity battle where Arlo must use his exploit to defeat a boss designed to be impossible for solo players.",
          "end_condition": "The Tutorial Guardian is defeated by a final, retreating blow.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "The Tutorial Guardian, a massive stone golem, awakens.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The boss battle begins.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Guardian's Arena",

              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Arlo begins the 'Coward's Dance', kiting the Guardian around the arena.",

              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Guardian's Arena",

              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "The Guardian uses an area-of-effect slam, nearly killing Arlo.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Arlo survives with 1 HP and uses a health potion.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARLO"],
              "location_start_label": "Guardian's Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Guardian's Arena",
              "location_start": "The perimeter of the arena.",
              "location_end": "A pile of rubble near the arena wall.",

              "transition_in_text": "The golem slams its fists into the ground, sending out a shockwave.",

              "transition_out_text": "The golem shatters into a thousand glowing fragments.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing fragments", "arena silence", "loot drop"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The Tutorial Guardian is defeated by a final, retreating blow."
